_comment: Q4 (plan-conversation-journal.md R3 + §7 q3, PO 2026-07-30): the simple version — three stages, no Miner leg. The traveller sits at (-20.6, -24.4) beside the tunnel mouth WITH a lamp he is done using (the kobolds are why he stopped travelling — that is how the Lampless name survives him handing one over); kill 6 kobolds (they nest north of the tunnel) and it is yours. Reward on the turn-in row (lampless-traveller.json): the Lantern aura + 700 XP. ⚑ L5b: with the 5 % Kobold drops deleted in the same chunk, that turn-in row is the ONLY source of Lantern in the world, and Lantern is the light the zone-1/2 tunnel is designed around — the quest is load-bearing content, pinned by TestContent_LanternHasAConversantSource. Abandon is safe (it re-offers, and the lifetime kill counters make re-acceptance instant).
title: The Traveller's Lamp

stages.journal: A traveller sits by the tunnel mouth, done travelling — the kobolds saw to that. Six of them dead, he says, and the lamp he has no more use for is mine.
Six kobolds down. The traveller is where I left him, lamp and all.
stages.tracker: Return to the traveller at the tunnel mouth

stages.journal: He handed the lamp over and showed me the trick of it — a lamp is not a thing you carry, it is a thing you learn. The tunnel looks less black already.
